notable_absence.finding: The promoted registry's analytics:service-level-configuration-parameter and analytics:node-specific-configuration-parameter concepts describe every Analytics setting as gated by one of two REST restart endpoints. This page's only settable option, --replicas, instead states a REBALANCE requirement ('Changing this setting will require a rebalance.') - a third activation mechanism absent from both existing categories and from the REST reference pages that defined them. Either the registry's two-category model is incomplete, or replica-count genuinely behaves differently from every other Analytics setting documented so far.

cross_component_finding: setting-analytics exposes exactly one settable option (--replicas); its Enterprise Analytics sibling, setting-enterprise-analytics, exposes eight (--partitions/--scheme/--bucket/--prefix/--region/--endpoint/--anonymous-auth/--path-style-addressing), none of which is --replicas. The two pages' settable surfaces have zero overlap - this is not a renamed copy of the same settings command, it manages a different configuration model entirely.
cross_product_finding: Title (H1, 'analytics-link-setup' family convention) and DESCRIPTION both read 'Manage Analytics service settings' verbatim, consistently naming the service 'Analytics service' throughout - unlike the eventing-function-setup page in this same batch, which drifts to 'Event service'. This page is internally consistent on naming; the drift problem this round is watching for shows up elsewhere in the batch, not here.
